AND THE ARCHIVE NOW HOLDS ITS FIRST ARC 15 FACT: DAKOTA BELLAMY MARRIES HER THERE. Every other wedding in this canon is filed in the past tense. This one is ahead of the writing edge, which currently sits at Arc 14 — the first thing in the ledger the family has not lived yet.
